findings: All requested existing deliverables are present in one Git checkout; final report and Level 3 are not started.
The 46 passed / 2 failed Windows result matches the 48-test suite; the two report-generator equality tests are the likely failures.
The most likely root cause is implicit locale-dependent encoding in open(OUT,"w") in both report generators; stdout redirection is not the cause.
Level 1 first cp1252 failure is U+2212; Level 2 first cp1252 failure is U+2192 and Level 2 has 7 unencodable character classes, so a one-character replacement is insufficient.
The generator failure can truncate its output file to 0 bytes; it is not merely cosmetic.
D-03 row-order mapping is implemented but unconfirmed against the original PDF; approximate 2% and 3% uncertainties were interpreted as relative SDs without inventing a more exact formula.
The 0.10 g/L CO2 floor is embedded in all kinetic fits and the frozen Level 2 selection but not in carbon-balance Monte Carlo; floor 0 and 0.5 sensitivities exist for Level 1 M0 only.
The D-24 code does not explicitly enforce the written multistart convergence condition, though current evidence shows all candidates converged 8/8.
Historical worklog/report statements about pytest execution conflict; this audit ran real pytest in a Linux sandbox and obtained 48 passed.
Frozen Level 1 and Level 2 hashes match current files; raw CSVs match the regenerated checksum file, but the original checksum file is unavailable.
Full Level 2 reproduction was intentionally not run because it would overwrite frozen outputs; only static, read-only computed and test-level sandbox checks were done.
